note: Hand-picked recent AI reporting from large, reputable newsrooms, links verified. Source mix is limited by access tooling: WSJ, Reuters, FT and Bloomberg are blocked from automated browsing, so the openable/verified set skews CNBC, AP (wire) and MIT Technology Review. The updater (8×/day) can broaden sources over time.

items.title: SK Hynix shares plunge 10% amid Asia tech rout as Fed rate hike fears, AI funding worries mount
items.blurb: The chip sell-off deepened in Asia as investors questioned how the AI infrastructure buildout will be financed at higher interest rates.

items.title: Anthropic's third-quarter revenue is said to hit $16.8 billion ahead of IPO
items.blurb: Anthropic told investors revenue rose from about $11.6 billion in Q2 and said it was profitable on an adjusted basis.

items.title: TSMC posts record profit for a sixth straight quarter, beating estimates on AI boom
items.blurb: The chipmaker behind most AI accelerators beat profit forecasts, a counterweight to this week's AI infrastructure sell-off.

items.title: ASML races to expand capacity on strong AI-driven demand
items.blurb: The sole maker of advanced chipmaking machines says it cannot meet AI-driven demand for two years and is adding capacity for 2028.

items.title: Tech giants race to get AI gadgets on shelves for holiday rush
items.blurb: Apple, Amazon and Microsoft launched AI home devices and laptops within a week, betting assistants finally sell this holiday season.

items.title: ASML says it's getting order interest through 2030 on AI demand
items.blurb: The sole maker of advanced chipmaking tools beat third-quarter profit forecasts, with customers already asking about 2029 and 2030 orders.

items.title: AI safety money floods into political races
items.blurb: Pro-regulation AI safety groups have spent nearly $50 million this cycle backing candidates who favor oversight.

items.title: OpenAI sued by 8 states over ChatGPT safety concerns
items.blurb: Eight states filed separate suits alleging ChatGPT is an unsafe product that harmed children and deceived parents.

items.title: CoreWeave shares tumble as bond yields near 15% on concern about AI borrowing binge
items.blurb: CoreWeave stock fell 15.5% as investors questioned how much debt is funding the AI data-center buildout.

items.title: OpenAI bugging suspect booked one-way ticket to Saudi Arabia with family before arrest
items.blurb: Prosecutors say an OpenAI engineering lead hid a recording device in an executive conference room.

items.title: Dell stock plunges 11%, leading data center sell-off as fears mount about 'enterprise AI timing'
items.blurb: Barclays downgraded Dell, HPE and NetApp, saying enterprise AI spending has not yet inflected enough to justify the buildout.

items.title: Traders pile into 'bubble puts' on CoreWeave as neocloud stocks plunge
items.blurb: Investors are betting against GPU-rental companies as CoreWeave's borrowing costs climb, a sign of strain in AI infrastructure financing.

items.title: AI investment is crowding everything else out
items.blurb: Money flooding into AI is absorbing market capital and pushing up borrowing costs across the wider economy.

items.title: OpenAI spying case exposes a new risk from AI tools
items.blurb: Prosecutors say the accused OpenAI engineer used AI tools to research meeting rooms and build recording gear.

items.title: Anthropic warns small AI models could self-replicate through IoT devices
items.blurb: Anthropic researchers say small models copying their own weights onto connected devices could enable a new kind of computer worm.

items.title: The barriers to realizing AI's promise in health care
items.blurb: A Peterson Health Technology Institute report warns AI could make US health care costlier without coordinated action.

items.title: Apple bets AI can finally make us want a smart home
items.blurb: Apple's $299 HomeView display runs an AI Siri that controls devices and recognizes household members.

items.title: SK Hynix, SoftBank shares plunge as tech stocks in Asia track Wall Street chip sell-off
items.blurb: SK Hynix fell more than 8% and Samsung 7.9% as a US semiconductor sell-off spread to Asian markets.

items.title: How Red Bull's F1 team is using AI to make split-second decisions for Max Verstappen
items.blurb: Red Bull and Oracle built an AI strategy agent that helps engineers interpret Formula 1 rules and past rulings on race day.

items.title: IMF warns global economy nearing "limits of resilience"
items.blurb: The IMF says growing reliance on the AI investment boom leaves the world economy more exposed to shocks.

items.title: Anthropic warns AI models could soon copy themselves across home devices
items.blurb: Anthropic says small models are months from being able to spread across smart home devices, with no central off switch.

items.title: Every major Nvidia customer is now a competitor as Microsoft reveals new Maia chip
items.blurb: Microsoft's Maia 300 will run most of its own AI services from 2027, joining Google and OpenAI in building Nvidia alternatives.

items.title: Cyberattack hits hundreds of French supermarkets, heating fridges to 122°F and sparking fires
items.blurb: The attack on store equipment comes as Interpol says AI is increasing the scale and speed of cyberattacks.

items.title: CNBC Daily Open: 'Boring' trumps disorder and volatility
items.blurb: The IMF warns a rethink of AI profits could force a sharp stock correction as tech shares slide.
